cards.title: The themes
cards.text: The looks a site can wear, one folder each: a theme is only values.

cards.title: Glass
cards.text: A site writes .Glass() among its areas, and its areas list the glass theme.

cards.title: Flat
cards.text: A site writes .Flat(), and its areas list the flat theme.

cards.title: The first is the default
cards.text: Each theme's id goes into the page; the first a site names is its default.

cards.title: Nothing else
cards.text: No theme registers a service, brings a page or names a component.
